WoodHouse13 | resources = [[Bee Nest]], [[Loot chest#Meadows / Black Forest Chest|Meadows chest]] }} '''Abandoned Houses''' are isolated ruined structures found in the [[Meadows]]. They are mostly made of [[Wood Structures]] and sometimes contain an unusable [[Bed]]. They come in 13 variants. When the houses are not isolated, they form either an [[Abandoned Village]] or a [[Draugr Village]]. ==Resources== Most version of abandoned Houses have a chance to contain a [[Meadows chest]] and a [[Bee Nest]]. {|class="wikitable" !Image !Version !Chest !Bee Nest !Note |- |[[File:Abandoned House 1.png|256px]] |1 | 50% | 25% | |- |[[File:Abandoned House 2.png|256px]] |2 | 50% | 25% | The chest has a 55% chance to contain a [[Mysterious axe head]]. |- |[[File:Abandoned House 3.png|256px]] |3 | No | 25% | Can be deconstructed for [[Corewood]]. |- |[[File:Abandoned House 4.png|256px]] |4 | No | 25% | |- |[[File:Abandoned House 5.png|256px]] |5 | No | 25% | |- |[[File:Abandoned House 6.png|256px]] |6 | 100% | 25% | The chest has a 55% chance to contain a [[Curious axe head]]. |- |[[File:Abandoned House 7.png|256px]] |7 | 50% | 25% | |- |[[File:Abandoned House 8.png|256px]] |8 | No | No | Contain up to 6 [[Dandelion]]s, with a 20% chance each. |- |[[File:Abandoned House 9.png|256px]] |9 | 50% | 25% | |- |[[File:Abandoned House 10.png|256px]] |10 | 50% | 25% | |- |[[File:Abandoned House 11.png|256px]] |11 | 50% | 25% | |- |[[File:Abandoned House 12.png|256px]] |12 | 50% | No | Up to 4 [[Mushroom]]s inside, with a 33% chance each. |- |[[File:Abandoned House 13.png|256px]] |13 | 50% | 25% | |} {{clear}} ==Notes== * Some of the more intact ones can be easily repaired, potentially serving as an expedient field base. * For isolated houses found in the [[Mountain]], see [[Abandoned Cabin]]. {{WorldNav}} [[Category:Points of interest]] [[ru:Заброшенный_дом]]

6000 (gates) | tool tier = 5 |resources = * [[Loot chest#Charred Fortress Charred Chests|Charred chest]] * [[Bell Fragment]] * [[Molten Core]] | resistances = pickaxe only | number = 20 }} '''Charred Fortresses''' are [[Points of interest]] in [[Ashlands]]. They are marked by a beam of green light shooting straight up into the sky, visible from a distance. == Location == Each world has 20 Charred Fortresses. They are always located away from the coasts between the inland lava fields, usually inside the central islands of the Ashlands. == Layout == The fortress consists of a tall, rectangular outer wall with many pillars and spiked bronze defenses. Two opposing outer walls have closed gates in them, leading to the interior area. The interior contains an expanse of ground littered with gravestones, with two [[Effigy of Malice|Effigies of Malice]] in the corners and two stone ramps leading up to the parapets atop the exterior walls. In the very center of the fortress interior is a tall tower, capped with more spiked defenses, which has one gate leading inside. The walls (of the exterior and of the interior tower), the pillars, gates and spiked defenses can all be destroyed, but only by [[Damage#Pickaxe|Pickaxe damage of tool tier 5 or higher]] - i.e. a [[Battering Ram]] or a [[Catapult]] with [[Explosive Payload]]s. The pillars have negligible (1) health but the walls (1500), spikes (1500) and especially the gates (6000) have much higher health. The exterior walls are three layers thick, whereas the interior tower walls are only one layer thick. The fortress initially spawns some creatures, independently to the Effigies of Malice, they do not respawn if killed: * Up to 3 [[Charred Warlock]]s (100% chance for the one on top of the tower and 60% chance to spawn for the other). * Up to 5 [[Charred Marksman|Charred Marksmen]] (100% chance for the one on top of the tower and 60% chance to spawn for the other). * Up to 4 [[Skugg]]s (80% chance for each corner of the fortress to have one). == Loot == Inside the central tower can be found: * A Bell Altar, drops 2 to 4 {{Item link|Bell Fragment}}s when destroyed. * A [[Loot chest#Charred Fortress Charred Chests|Charred chest]]. * A [[Vegvisir|Fader Vegvisir]] with a 50% chance to spawn. * 2 [[Molten Core]]s. Other places inside the Fortress: * The interior court can have up to 8 [[Molten Core]]s, with a 5% chance each to spawn. * Up to 3 Charred chests can spawn along the solid walls of the tower (clockwise from the tower entrance: 100%, 13% and 50% chances to spawn). * [[Skugg]] drop {{item link|Charred Cogwheel}}s which allow the player to make a [[Catapult]]. * The bronze spike strips can be destroyed to drop 2-5 [[Scrap Bronze]] each. As each Charred Fortress contains exactly 78 spike strips, one fortress will yield an average of 273 scrap bronze. The content of Charred Chests is: {{Chest|Charred Chest}} == Notes == * The exterior walls (3 layers x 1500 health = 4500 total) are easier to break through than the gates (6000 health). The tower walls (1500 health) are easier still, but be careful not to accidentally destroy any loot (see below). * The Charred chests and the Bell fragment altar are destroyable; while the chests have 200 health and are resistant to most types of damage (except for [[Damage#Lightning|Lightning]], [[Damage#Poison|Poison]] and [[Damage#Spirit|Spirit]]), the altar is extremely fragile - having only 10 health and no damage resistances. * The presence of the Bell fragment altar is indicated by a huge vertical beacon of light, which can be seen at a distance. This beacon can help identify the location of intact fortresses from afar. ** Destroying the altar also removes the beacon. * The eastern and western smaller islands usually generate with no fortress, thus it is best to first land directly south of spawn. * Some segments of the walls can be mined with any pickaxe. This might be due to a bug. == Tips == * A simple strategy to conquer Charred Fortresses is to first master one Charred Fortress, obtain a [[Bloodstone]], and then craft the [[Trollstav]]. Now, the player can easily approach a Charred Fortress and summon [[Summoned Troll]]s from the outside, which will handle the fortress without any issues. Finally, kill the Troll and enjoy the loot! * It is easier to build a wooden ladder to get on top of the wall rather than using a [[Battering Ram]] to destroy the gates/walls. And, if you are lucky with the world generation, you could use one of the naturally spawning giant rocks to get inside too. Once on top of the walls, simply run circles in the walls and slowly kill enemies and destroy the [[Effigy of Malice|spawners]], if you get overwhelmed just jump off outside (be careful if there is lava). * You can destroy the [[Skugg|skuggs]] from outside the fortress with the bow/crossbow or magic, and from a high enough place you can also destroy the [[Effigy of Malice|spawners]] too. * If you conquered the fortress and didn´t destroy the walls/gates to get inside, the fortress is now a perfect place to build a mini base, thanks to the indestructible walls. Only the flying [[Fallen Valkyrie|valkyries]] and [[Volture|Voltures]] can get inside. * There are two ways to get inside the central tower without a [[Battering Ram]]. First is to make a hole on the ground with a pickaxe and simply pass below the wall of the tower (this may not work if you hit the limit on how low the ground can go). Second is to get on top of the tower and get inside through the hole between the spikes, to get out you will need to either portal out or build yourself ladders/platforms to pass through the hole between the spikes again. == Gallery == Charred fortress tower interior.png|The inside of a Charred Fortress tower. At front are two Molten cores; at back are the Bell fragment altar and a Charred chest. The Vegvisir would be at the back left, if it were present. '''Early Axes''' are the first dual wielded [[Axes|axe]]. Its primary attack is a 4-step combo: two single hits, one with each axe, followed by two double hits using both axes simultaneously, resulting in a total of 6 hits. The final double hit deals 2x damage with each individual hit. Its secondary attack costs 16 stamina and is a leap forward, followed by a slash with both axes for a single hit, dealing 2x the damage. The Early Axes deal [[Chop]] damage and can cut down the same trees as the [[Bronze Axe]], such as [[Birch]]es, [[Oak]]s and [[Ancient Tree]]s. == Crafting == Early Axes can be crafted at a [[Workbench]] with [[Wood]], [[Leather Scraps]] and two rare components: * '''{{Item link|Curious Axe Head|nolink=1}}''' can be found inside a chest in variant 6 of the [[Abandoned House]]. * '''{{Item link|Mysterious Axe Head|nolink=1}}''' can be found inside a chest in variant 2 of the Abandoned House. {| class="wikitable" !Quality !1 !2 !3 !4 !Total |- !Slash |30 |35 |40 |45 | |- !Durability |175 |225 |275 |325 | |- !Crafting |1 Curious Axe Head
